artwork.title: Artwork Upload
artwork.formats: PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIF, TIFF, EPS · max 20 MB
artwork.canvas_label: Print template preview. Use arrow keys to move the artwork, plus and minus to scale.
artwork.drag_hint: Drag the artwork (or use arrow keys) to position it. Keep text inside the blue line; everything past the red line is trimmed.
artwork.production_note: Your project goes into production once artwork is submitted and the purchase is completed. Please review the warnings before adding to cart.
artwork.bad_format: {name} isn't accepted for this product. Use {formats}.

artwork.no_preview: {name} can't be previewed in the browser. Only file type and size were checked; our team will review it.

artwork_dropoff.step_1: Find your order number (e.g. #1234) in your confirmation email.

artwork_dropoff.step_4: We'll reply within one business day if anything needs fixing. Production starts once the files are approved.
artwork_dropoff.large_files: Files over 20 MB: send a WeTransfer, Google Drive or Dropbox link in the email instead of attaching.
artwork_dropoff.mail_body:
Hi PRINTR, attached is the artwork for order {order}.

Product(s):
Notes:
